questions.question_text: You have been asked to manage access to an Azure subscription. Which built-in role should you assign to a user to allow them to only view all resources in the subscription without making any changes?
questions.explanation: The Reader role allows a user to view all resources in a subscription but not make any changes. It is a read-only role suitable for monitoring and reporting purposes.

questions.question_text: A developer needs to manage virtual machines in a specific resource group but should not have the ability to manage other resources. Which role and scope should you assign?

options.label: A
options.text: Owner role at the subscription scope

options.label: B
options.text: Contributor role at the resource group scope

options.label: C
options.text: Virtual Machine Contributor role at the resource group scope

options.label: D
options.text: Reader role at the resource group scope

questions.explanation: Assigning the Contributor role at the resource group scope allows the developer to manage all resources within that resource group but not beyond it.

questions.question_text: You need to ensure a user can grant access to other users in a resource group but cannot alter resources. Which role should you assign?
questions.explanation: The User Access Administrator role allows a user to manage access to resources and assign roles in Azure without altering the resources themselves.

questions.question_text: A security audit requires you to review the access assignments for a specific resource in Azure. Which tool or feature should you use to interpret these assignments effectively?

options.label: D
options.text: Azure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Access Control (IAM) blade

questions.explanation: The Access Control (IAM) blade in Azure allows you to view and manage role assignments for resources, which is essential for interpreting access assignments.

questions.question_text: You need to ensure that a user can manage only the billing information for an Azure subscription but cannot modify any other resources. Which built-in role would you assign?
questions.explanation: The Billing Contributor role allows a user to manage billing information but does not grant access to modify resources in the subscription.
